agent_configuration_followup.scope: Documented supplied interfaces; no runtime repair benchmark performed
agent_configuration_followup.conclusion: Partial overlaps exist. No documented supplied equivalent to the full local MCP-callable OpenAPI import, catalog patch, configuration repair, and shared TUI execution loop was verified among reviewed competitors. This is not a universal uniqueness claim.

agent_authored_schema_followup.clarification: A vendor-published OpenAPI document is not required. An external agent can author a supported document and pass its JSON/YAML string directly to MCP validation, preview, and import through source, optionally setting source_type=inline. Structured document strings are auto-detected when the type is omitted. Paths and URLs remain supported; no intermediate source file is required.
agent_authored_schema_followup.verification: 18 MCP catalog tests passed, including inline JSON/YAML validation, preview, import/persistence/reload, malformed document errors, and explicit/inferred path/URL loading against a local fixture server. Isolated full workspace tests passed: 538 passed, 0 failed, 27 ignored. Tests used temporary REGISTRY_CONFIG_PATH/REGISTRY_CATALOGS_PATH and OATTY_SECRETS_BACKEND=env, with --test-threads=1. Formatting and diff checks passed. Strict workspace Clippy encountered existing useless_borrows_in_formatting and async-trait-generated double_must_use warnings under Rust 1.99; workspace Clippy and MCP all-targets Clippy passed with those two baseline categories exempted. Agent schema generation and live vendor API correctness were not benchmarked.
agent_authored_schema_followup.competitive_inference: Other products accepting supplied OpenAPI documents can also consume compatible agent-authored schemas; the integrated MCP onboarding, repair, and shared TUI execution loop remains the bounded differentiation hypothesis.
agent_authored_schema_followup.implementation_change: Inline MCP source input was added in the current local checkout after review confirmed the earlier interface supported only path/URL. This does not establish availability in the published release.
validation_commands: cargo clippy -p oatty-mcp --all-targets -- -D warnings -A clippy::useless_borrows_in_formatting -A clippy::double_must_use (passed)

agent_observability_followup.methodology: Primary product documentation and static source inspection; GitHub issue state checked through the public GitHub API. No runtime integration, comparative benchmark, representative demand study, or customer interview performed.

interpretation: Terminal visibility, saved sessions, replay, trace export, and agent-assisted diagnosis already have documented alternatives.
Current Oatty code includes structured request/result inspection, best-effort persistent TUI logs, plugin invocation audit, workflow step events, and limited workflow history.
MCP runner request IDs are zero on inspected execution paths; unified causal correlation, schema revision lineage, and OpenTelemetry export require development and validation.
Oatty opportunity hypothesis: connect API execution evidence to agent-configurable catalogs, direct human execution, repair, and verification.
Closed issue reports record historical needs and are not counted as current unresolved competitor gaps; issue state does not prove a bug is reproduced or fixed.

Adjacent hypotheses added: versioned tested repairs, catalog drift, declared outcome verification, portable integration bundles, and concrete action review. Schemathesis documents stateful API testing and adaptive constraint learning; these mechanisms are not novel in isolation. No added hypotheses were runtime-tested.
